description: List, create, delete, save (export) and load (import) custom stroke styles: dashed, dotted and striped patterns (Stroke panel menu > Stroke Styles)

action.description: list every stroke style; create, delete, export (Save) or import (Load) custom styles

cap.description: create: Cap of a dashed style's dashes

cornerAdjustment.description: create: Corners for a dashed or dotted style

names.description: export: the styles to save (default: every custom style)

path.description: export, import: a stroke styles file (.inst)

pattern.description: create: dashed, dash and gap lengths in points, in pairs; dotted, dot centre distances in points; striped, pairs of [top, bottom] stripe edges as % of the stroke weight

replaceWith.description: delete: the stroke style applied where the deleted one was used (default "Solid")

name: manage_stroke_styles
title: Manage Stroke Styles
